data.name: GameStateDescription
data.value: Where the game is and whether the DotaTune pack is in place.

data.name: EffectsDescription
data.value: Removes effects that cost frames and tell you nothing about the game. Abilities and sounds stay.

data.name: ClicksDescription
data.value: Your own colours for clicks, selection and the minimap.

data.name: MenuBackgroundDescription
data.value: A black background or your own picture instead of the 3D scene in the menu. Easier on the video card.

data.name: HeroGridDescription
data.value: Ready-made hero layouts by position for the grid on the pick screen.

data.name: ConfigDescription
data.value: Commands the game runs at start and the Steam launch options.

data.name: ResetDescription
data.value: Takes everything DotaTune put in out of the game.

data.name: LanguageHint
data.value: The language of the game and of Windows stays as it is.

data.name: ActionUseVoiceFolder
data.value: The pack goes next to the game files, game settings stay as they are.

data.name: ActionSwitchToCarrier
data.value: DotaTune switches the voice language to {0} so the game loads the pack. Voices stay English, the game text does not change.

data.name: ActionUseLaunchLanguageFolder
data.value: The pack goes where the -language {0} launch option points.

data.name: ActionOfferRemoveEnglishOverride
data.value: The -language english launch option keeps the game from loading mods. Remove it in Steam and choose English text in the game settings.

data.name: ActionOfferRemoveForeignOverride
data.value: The launch options still have -language {0}, usually left from Minify. With it the game shows text in that language.

data.name: ActionNoCarrier
data.value: The pack cannot go in without changing the voices in the game, so DotaTune installs nothing.

data.name: ActionStartGameOnce
data.value: Start the game once, quit it and refresh this page.

data.name: ActionUnknownBootFormat
data.value: The game seems to work differently after an update. DotaTune writes nothing to it for now.

data.name: ProblemDotaNotFound
data.value: Dota 2 is not in any Steam library.

data.name: ProblemNoAccount
data.value: Cannot tell which account is signed in to Steam. Start Steam and refresh the page.

data.name: DotaRunningNote
data.value: Dota is running. The pack can be installed or removed after you quit the game.

data.name: HealthMissing
data.value: The DotaTune pack is gone, usually after Steam verified the game files. Install it again.

data.name: HealthChanged
data.value: The pack file was replaced, DotaTune leaves it alone. Install the pack again.

data.name: HealthFolderNotLoaded
data.value: The voice language changed and the game no longer sees the pack. Install it again.

data.name: HealthOtherBuild
data.value: The game was updated, install the pack again.

data.name: RefusedNoFreeSlot
data.value: There is no room for the pack: other mods took every free place.

data.name: RefusedWrittenFileDiffers
data.value: The pack was written with an error and taken out. Check free space on the game disk.

data.name: PlayWaiting
data.value: Starting the game and waiting for it to load the pack…

data.name: PlayDidNotStart
data.value: The game did not start within three minutes. Look at Steam: it may be waiting for sign-in or updating the game.

data.name: PlayClosedEarly
data.value: The game closed before it showed whether the pack was loaded.

data.name: PlayNoSearchPaths
data.value: The game is running, but the pack could not be checked.

data.name: EffectWeatherDescription
data.value: Rain, snow and other weather from the map and from cosmetics.

data.name: EffectMapAmbienceDescription
data.value: Critters, lights, smoke and lava on the terrain.

data.name: EffectEventCosmeticsDescription
data.value: Emblems, hat effects, kill banners and fireworks from events.

data.name: EffectSpraysDescription
data.value: Pictures players leave on the map.

data.name: EffectCosmeticWardsDescription
data.value: Glow and particles of cosmetic wards. The ward itself is seen as usual.

data.name: EffectAttackFlashesDescription
data.value: Flashes, trails and hits of hero attack projectiles. The projectile itself still flies.

data.name: EffectBuildingAmbienceDescription
data.value: Lights of barracks, statues, the fountain, base gates and tower lamps. Destruction, shrines, teleports and portals look as usual.

data.name: EffectFogMistDescription
data.value: The drifting veil over ground out of sight. The darkening stays, so the edge of vision is still clear.

data.name: EffectCosmeticAmbienceDescription
data.value: Sparks, smoke and glow that hero and courier items wear all the time. The items themselves and their look in spells stay.

data.name: EffectsNoPack
data.value: No pack yet. The empty effects go in with it.

data.name: EffectsPackMatches
data.value: The pack is installed with these groups.

data.name: EffectsPackDiffers
data.value: The pack was built with other groups.

data.name: ConfigFriendlyDescription
data.value: Creeps and buildings of your side

data.name: ConfigEnemyDescription
data.value: Creeps and buildings of the other side

data.name: ConfigHideVideo
data.value: No video on the main page

data.name: ConfigHideVideoDescription
data.value: The main menu page does not play its video

data.name: ConfigMenuFpsDescription
data.value: Frame limit outside a match, the match itself is not affected

data.name: ConfigNoParticleLightsDescription
data.value: Fights are easier on the graphics card, effects look dimmer

data.name: ConfigMinimalismDescription
data.value: The popular config: no colour correction on the map, no blood, simpler particles and shadows

data.name: ConfigNotWrittenYet
data.value: The choice is not in autoexec.cfg yet.

data.name: ConfigWritten
data.value: Written to autoexec.cfg. The game takes it at the next start.

data.name: ConfigMissing
data.value: The DotaTune lines are gone from autoexec.cfg.

data.name: ConfigChanged
data.value: The DotaTune lines in autoexec.cfg were edited by hand.

data.name: ConfigDotaRunning
data.value: Dota is running. DotaTune writes and removes its lines after you leave the game.

data.name: ConfigBrokenMarksFormat
data.value: The DotaTune marks in autoexec.cfg are broken. Fix the file by hand: {0}

data.name: LaunchNoVideoDescription
data.value: -novid, the game starts without the Valve video

data.name: LaunchNoJoystickDescription
data.value: -nojoy, a slightly faster start, FPS is not affected

data.name: LaunchRemoveDead
data.value: Remove what the game no longer has

data.name: LaunchWritten
data.value: Launch options are written. Steam takes them at the next start of the game.

data.name: LaunchSteamRunning
data.value: Steam is running. Launch options can be written only while Steam is closed.

data.name: LaunchNoDotaBlock
data.value: Dota has not been started on this account yet, so there is nowhere to write the options.

data.name: LaunchRestored
data.value: Launch options are put back as they were.

data.name: LaunchChangedInSteam
data.value: The line was changed in Steam after DotaTune wrote it, so it stays as it is.

data.name: LaunchSteamDidNotClose
data.value: Steam did not close within a minute, nothing is written. If it closes later, start it yourself.

data.name: LaunchSteamClosing
data.value: Steam is closing, this can take up to a minute.

data.name: LaunchSteamDidNotStart
data.value: Steam did not start, open it yourself.

data.name: LaunchDotaRunning
data.value: Dota is running. Launch options can be written after you quit the game.

data.name: TransferConsoleBindsDescription
data.value: Keys bound with the bind command

data.name: TransferHeroGridsDescription
data.value: Added next to the account's own grids, tagged #DotaTune

data.name: TransferMiscDescription
data.value: Item suggestions, unit groups, chat, lobby

data.name: TransferRestored
data.value: The account is put back as it was before the transfer.

data.name: TransferChangedSince
data.value: Put back, except what changed after the transfer: those files stay as they are.

data.name: TransferCloudHintFormat
data.value: Steam Cloud is on for {0}. If Steam shows a sync conflict at the next start, pick the files on this computer, or it brings the old ones back.

data.name: TransferDotaRunning
data.value: Dota is running. Settings can be transferred after you exit the game.

data.name: TransferSteamRunning
data.value: Steam is running. Launch options are transferred only while Steam is closed: untick them or close Steam.

data.name: TransferNothing
data.value: The source account has none of the chosen settings.

data.name: TransferNoSuchAccount
data.value: One of the accounts no longer has its Dota folder.

data.name: TransferOneAccount
data.value: Dota has been started on only one account of this computer.

data.name: PresetExportNote
data.value: The code carries the effects, config and launch options. Hero grids, hotkeys and game settings go only in a file

data.name: PresetUnknownFormat
data.value: Not applied, this version does not know: {0}

data.name: PresetAppliedFormat
data.value: The preset is applied: the choice is on the pages, files written: {0}.

data.name: PresetNotAPreset
data.value: This is not a DotaTune preset.

data.name: PresetNewer
data.value: The preset comes from a newer DotaTune. Update the program to load it.

data.name: PresetDamaged
data.value: The preset is damaged: the code is cut or changed, or the file is broken.

data.name: PresetCopyFailed
data.value: The clipboard is busy with another program. The code is shown above, it can be selected and copied by hand.

data.name: GridMarkHint
data.value: In the grid editor DotaTune layouts carry the #DotaTune-Import tag. Your own grids stay as they are.

data.name: GridCatalogBuiltInFormat
data.value: Layouts from Stratz and Spectral statistics, built into the program, from {0}.

data.name: GridCatalogDownloadedFormat
data.value: Layouts from Stratz and Spectral statistics, downloaded {0}. They are rebuilt once a day.

data.name: GridFileAddedFormat
data.value: Layouts taken from {1}: {0}. They are on; write them to the game.

data.name: GridFileProblemFormat
data.value: The file has no hero grids the game would show: {0}

data.name: GridNoneInGame
data.value: No DotaTune layouts in the game

data.name: GridMatches
data.value: The chosen layouts are in the game

data.name: GridNewer
data.value: A fresh version of the layouts in the game is here

data.name: GridDiffers
data.value: The choice is not written to the game yet

data.name: GridDotaRunning
data.value: Dota is running. Grids can be changed after you quit the game.

data.name: GridNoAccount
data.value: Cannot tell which account is signed in to Steam, or Dota was never started on it. Start Steam and open the page again.

data.name: GridBrokenFormat
data.value: The hero grid file is broken, DotaTune leaves it alone. {0}

data.name: GridDoneFormat
data.value: Done: {0} added, {1} taken out. The grid editor shows the change from the next start of the game.

data.name: GridNotStarted
data.value: This account has not started Dota yet, the game has no settings folder for it.

data.name: GridNotSeen
data.value: The game does not see this account's grid file yet. Save any grid of your own on the Heroes page in the game, quit and write again.

data.name: TransferGridsNotSeen
data.value: Hero grids were not written: the game does not see this account's grid file yet. Save any grid of your own on the Heroes page in the game, quit and transfer again.

data.name: MenuPictureHint
data.value: The picture is cropped around the centre to fit the screen.

data.name: MenuNoPack
data.value: No pack yet. The menu background goes in with it.

data.name: MenuPackMatches
data.value: The pack is installed with this background. Dota shows it from its next start.

data.name: MenuPackDiffers
data.value: The pack was built with another background.

data.name: MenuNotApplied
data.value: The background did not go into the pack, the reason is in the log.

data.name: MenuNotSupported
data.value: DotaTune cannot change the menu background in this game version.

data.name: MenuPictureNotSupported
data.value: This game version cannot show a picture in the menu; the default and black backgrounds still work.

data.name: MenuPictureUnreadable
data.value: This file did not open as a picture, or it is too large.

data.name: ClicksMoveDescription
data.value: Arrows and rings where you sent your hero.

data.name: ClicksAttackDescription
data.value: The same for an attack order. Red in the game.

data.name: ClicksUnitDescription
data.value: The ring on a unit you give an order on, such as the enemy you attack. Red on enemies in the game.

data.name: ClicksRingsDescription
data.value: Rings under selected units and from a selection box. Own and enemy units get the same colour.

data.name: ClicksHeroDescription
data.value: The glow that shows where your hero is.

data.name: ColorsApplied
data.value: The colours are in the game.

data.name: ColorsNotApplied
data.value: The colours are not in the game yet.

data.name: ColorsAsInGame
data.value: Colours as the game has them.

data.name: ColorsDotaRunning
data.value: Dota is running. The colours can be applied after you quit the game.

data.name: ClicksNotTakenFormat
data.value: Not recoloured: {0}. The game was probably updated, details are in the log.

data.name: ResetConfirm
data.value: Put the game back the way it was before DotaTune?

data.name: ResetDotaRunning
data.value: Dota is running. Reset works after you quit the game.

data.name: ResetProblemAutoexecFormat
data.value: DotaTune marks in the file are broken, fix it by hand: {0}

data.name: ResetProblemLaunchChanged
data.value: the line was changed in Steam and stays as it is

data.name: ResetProblemTransferChanged
data.value: files changed after the transfer stay as they are

data.name: ResetProblemGridsFormat
data.value: the file does not read and stays as it is: {0}

data.name: StatePackReady
data.value: The DotaTune pack is in place.

data.name: PlayPackLoaded
data.value: The game loaded the DotaTune pack.

data.name: PlayPackNotLoaded
data.value: The game started without the DotaTune pack. Install it again.

data.name: StateOldPack
data.value: An old DotaTune pack is left in the game, Reset takes it out.

data.name: MmrDescription
data.value: Your MMR next to your name in the main menu, and its change after games next to the number in your profile. The game gives the number when you open your profile yourself.

data.name: MmrNoPack
data.value: No pack yet. The MMR line goes in with it.

data.name: MmrPackWithLine
data.value: The pack is in place with the MMR line.

data.name: MmrPackWithoutLine
data.value: The pack is in place without the MMR line.

data.name: MmrPackBuiltWithLine
data.value: The pack was built with the MMR line.

data.name: MmrPackBuiltWithoutLine
data.value: The pack was built without the MMR line.

data.name: MmrNotSupported
data.value: The main menu of this game version is built differently, the MMR line cannot go in.

data.name: MmrNotApplied
data.value: The MMR line did not go into the pack, the log has the reason.

data.name: MmrHistoryUnreadable
data.value: The history file mmr.json is unreadable, DotaTune leaves it as it is

data.name: MmrConsoleLogHint
data.value: Without -condebug in the launch options the history is kept only when the game is started from DotaTune

data.name: LaunchConsoleLogDescription
data.value: -condebug, DotaTune keeps the MMR history from it

data.name: AutoAcceptDescription
data.value: A found match is accepted on its own the chosen number of seconds after the window shows. If you accept first, DotaTune stays out of it.

data.name: AutoAcceptNoPack
data.value: No pack yet. Auto accept goes in with it.

data.name: AutoAcceptPackOff
data.value: The pack is in place without auto accept.

data.name: AutoAcceptBuiltOnFormat
data.value: The pack was built to accept after {0} s.

data.name: AutoAcceptBuiltOff
data.value: The pack was built without auto accept.

data.name: AutoAcceptNotSupported
data.value: The match accept window of this game version is built differently, auto accept cannot go in.

data.name: AutoAcceptNotApplied
data.value: Auto accept did not go into the pack, the log has the reason.

data.name: AutoAcceptNotReplaced
data.value: The delay in the pack did not change, the log has the reason.
